localizedValues.name: S1-Upper Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description: The upper kitchen shelter is near swings and a tunnel that connects to a baseball field and tennis courts. The shelter has no electrical outlets. Parking is limited.  Car pooling is encouraged.

localizedValues.name: S2-Lower Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description: The S2-Lower Picnic Shelter  is located near the park amphitheatre and has a view of Sequim Bay. The shelter has no electrical outlets. The shelter has a  maximum parking limit of 8 passenger vehicles. Arrangements for parking more or larger vehicles may be possible by contacting park staff more than 30 days prior to the reservation date.
This site is set aside for campground host. Drive Length:29ft, no tent pad.   a 10 ft overhang behind the bumperblock allows a 39ft RV to fit in the site.
